title: 🔔 Notifications
notes: 🔔 Push notifications are here. Tap the bell at the top to turn them on for this device (on iPhone, add the app to your Home Screen first).
🤝 Trades: get pinged when someone sends you an offer, when your offer is accepted, declined or countered, and when a trade goes through.
🏈 Game day: touchdowns and 5+ point plays by your players, a lineup warning before kickoff if a starter is out or on bye, close-game alerts and your final score.
💬 Chat: hear about every message, only when someone @s you (the default), or nothing at all.
📊 A Tuesday-morning Front Office digest with your value risers and fallers, plus a sell-high and a buy-low idea.
🤫 Every alert has its own switch, plus quiet hours, a 24-hour pause and a daily cap, so your phone won't get blown up.
